events.subject: event:ev_qin_mie_liu_guo_01
events.title: 秦攻赵之战
events.text: 王翦、端和、羌瘣分路攻赵，围邯郸

events.subject: event:ev_qin_mie_liu_guo_02
events.title: 灭赵俘王
events.text: 王翦、羌瘣定赵地东阳，俘赵王迁

events.subject: event:ev_qin_mie_liu_guo_03
events.title: 荆轲刺秦
events.text: 燕太子丹遣荆轲刺秦王，事败被杀

events.subject: event:ev_qin_mie_liu_guo_04
events.title: 秦灭魏
events.text: 王贲引河沟灌大梁，魏王请降

events.subject: event:ev_qin_mie_liu_guo_05
events.title: 灭燕代
events.text: 王贲攻燕辽东得燕王喜，还攻代虏代王嘉
